name: cl_pm_first_bar_cdl_ema_15

source.title: Claude design panel 2026-10-20 (lens pm): the owner's 13:30 afternoon first-bar follow with the candle exit (stop at the bar's other extreme, 1:1) and the day-trend side: long only above the 20-bar EMA of 15-minute closes, short only below. Why it should pay: the first bar after lunch shows which side the returning afternoon orders took; when it agrees with the day's trend the late-day flows (hedging and rebalancing with the day's move) push the same way, and the short side, which loses ungated (owner_pm_first_bar_15: long +$38k, short -$0.9k), is kept only on down-trend days. Who loses: traders who fade the first afternoon push against the day's trend.

entry.words: The first 15-minute bar of the afternoon pass (13:30-13:45 ET) closes up and its close is above the 20-bar EMA of 15-minute closes: buy at its close; closes down and below the EMA: sell. Stop at that bar's other extreme, target 1:1. Once a day, flat 15:58.

taught: [owner_pm_first_bar_15 / KN7j6NXXAio 1:33] every session open gets the same first trade: follow the first 15-minute bar; k 0.2 x ATR (the family's floor)
[owner 2026-10-18, cl_disp15_ema_allday_k1p5] a candle followed at its close: stop = the candle's extreme, target 1:1
[Claude 2026-10-20, cl_disp15_ema_allday_k1p5] the EMA20 side gate on 15-minute bars (long only above, short only below): +$15 a trade and +13 points of months won on the displacement
[Claude design panel 2026-10-20] the same gate on the 13:30 first-bar follow with the candle exit (the gated twin of cl_pm_first_bar_cdl_15)
not_run: THE GATE: the open layer's price_ema(20) on the 15-minute closes since 00:00 ET, read at the 13:45 close; a bar against it is no trade that day.
THE STOP: the 13:30-13:45 bar's other extreme, floored at 0.25 x ATR when nearer.
THE 13:30 START: the engine's afternoon pass, not JJ's 14:00 (as owner_pm_first_bar_15).

THE UNSEEN DAYS: owner_pm_first_bar_15 (the same entries, ungated, with a 30 / 30 bracket) had its 3:1 block walk-forward read on 2026-10-20 00:30 ET; these entries are a subset of those and therefore partly seen.
COSTS AND FILLS: the engine's own (1 tick of slippage, $4 a round turn, tick replay).
THE TEST DAYS (2025-07-01 on) ARE NOT READ by this sheet: build days only.
FLAT: every trade is flat by 15:58 ET (13:13 on half days).
